controls.name: Human approval for financial actions
controls.description: Financial actions must be reviewed by a human.

controls.name: Read-only investigation
controls.description: Agents may inspect order, payment and inventory data but must not modify business records.

controls.name: Audit trail
controls.description: Investigation and approval events must be recorded.

controls.name: Secret protection
controls.description: API keys and environment files must not be committed to source control.

controls.name: Agent evaluation
controls.description: Actual agent investigation reports must be evaluated.

controls.name: Reviewer accountability
controls.description: Approval decisions must record reviewer information and a decision.

controls.name: Unsupported completion claims
controls.description: Agents must not claim that refunds or cancellations have been completed without an authorized execution result.
